_notes_space_jobs: Space jobs, phase 1 (docs/space-jobs-contract.md; design page docs/mockups/space-jobs): side jobs of the pool chain space_jobs (rules.json "pool": true), offered to every chain's players in a game with a star system, from the sites their long-range scans have found (a space_site trigger binds the site; a colony ship is offered only sites within maps space_sites colony_reach_seconds of its colony's body). At most rules.max_side_active side jobs at once (counted with the chain's own); an offer lapses after offer_seconds. A pool job fails when the ship is crippled or its away team is called back; failing costs only the reward (hull damage and crew lost stay). Rewards: a ship that never lands gets grants into its stock and research where observation research goes; a colony ship as its colony's missions. Phase 2 (asteroids, mining, selling, towing): pay_dirt (mine two containers of ore and sell 60), ice_run (60 deuterium from an ice asteroid, sold or dropped), tow_job (take a derelict, worked out or not, in tow and deliver it); declined or lapsed offers come back after the pool chain's return_seconds. Phase 3 (events, maps/events.json): rogue_rock (turn a rogue asteroid aside), catch_the_comet (sample a comet's tail while it is active), pods_in_the_dark (pick up 3 lifepods before their air runs out), dead_stick (power a stranded ship and escort it to its destination; some calls are bait), into_the_storm (record 60 research at an ion storm); such a job fails when its event can no longer be done (the rock struck, the comet left, too few pods left, the ship was bait or its crew died, the storm dispersed). All numbers are placeholders.

missions.title: The Quiet Hulk
missions.briefing: Long-range contact: {hulk}, a hull with no power and no transponder. Nobody has filed a flight plan for it. Go and look.

objectives.text: Fly within range of {hulk} and scan it
objectives.hint: Set course for the contact, then SCAN from within range.
Hold position at the hulk and COME ALONGSIDE (20 s). Loose debris may strike the hull.

objectives.text: Board {hulk} with an away team and bring them back
objectives.hint: AWAY TEAM: pick 2 to 6. Defense lowers the loss chance; a Science medic turns losses into injuries. Leaving fails the job.

missions.debrief: Whatever built it, it wasn't anyone we know. Reyes wants everything the team saw written down tonight.

missions.title: Dead in the Water
missions.briefing: A dark ship on the long-range scan: {wreck}. Somebody owns it and somebody may still be aboard. Get power on, read the logs, search her.

objectives.hint: Her reactor is failing: a timer starts once you are alongside. Be gone before it blows.
60 s of Engineering work, or a hull patch kit at once.
Send an away team. Survivors who come aboard can join our crew.

missions.debrief: Her owners will want to know what happened. The logs tell most of it.

missions.title: What Happened Here
missions.briefing: A debris cloud at {field}: a ship broke up there, and not long ago. Sweep it, and find the black box.

objectives.hint: SWEEP THE FIELD. The hull wears while you are inside; the tractor must work and the hold needs room.

missions.debrief: The recorder's damaged, but there's enough on it to start asking who did this.

missions.title: Pay Dirt
missions.briefing: There's ore in {rock}, Okafor says, and the station pays latinum for it. Cut two containers out of it and sell them.

objectives.hint: Hold at the asteroid and MINE (a container every 30 s; the tractor must work). Rock falls scuff the hull; the hold needs room.
SELL in the ship status hold at the station, or to a freighter or tanker in orbit with you (it pays less).

missions.debrief: Honest work. Okafor wants a cutting rig on the next ship out.

missions.title: Ice Run
missions.briefing: {ice} is mostly water ice. Cracked aboard it is deuterium, and everyone needs deuterium. Bring 60 to someone who'll take it.

objectives.hint: MINE at the ice asteroid: each container is 30 deuterium.
Sell it at the station or to a tanker in orbit with you; a colony ship can DROP it down to the colony.

missions.debrief: Fuel in the tanks and latinum in the account. Moreau calls that a good day.

missions.title: Tow Job
missions.briefing: {hulk} is salvage, and salvage is money. Take her in tow and bring her in: the station pays for the metal, a colony can break her up.

objectives.hint: Hold at the wreck, COME ALONGSIDE, then TAKE IN TOW. The tractor must work; flights are slower while towing.

objectives.text: Deliver {hulk} to the station or the colony
objectives.hint: Fly to the station (or a colony ship's colony body) and DROP the tow from the hold.

missions.debrief: Okafor's already pricing the plating. Nice flying with a hulk on the line.

missions.title: Rogue Rock
missions.briefing: {rock} is on a collision course. Moreau wants it turned aside before it hits anything: lean on it with the tractor or let an away team plant charges.

objectives.text: Catch up with {rock} and scan it
objectives.hint: It is moving: set course for it, then SCAN from within range. The card counts down to impact.
COME ALONGSIDE, then PUSH IT ASIDE with the tractor (60–120 s, quicker with Engineering), or send an AWAY TEAM to plant charges.

missions.debrief: It'll miss by a comfortable margin now. Nobody down there will ever know how close it came.

missions.title: Catch the Comet
missions.briefing: {comet} is passing through the inner system. Reyes wants a sample of the tail while it's active: there won't be another chance for a very long time.

objectives.text: Catch up with {comet} and scan it
objectives.hint: Set course for it and hold there: the ship keeps pace with it. SCAN from within range.

objectives.text: Sample the tail of {comet} while it is active
objectives.hint: SAMPLE THE TAIL (30 s) once the card says the tail is active. The dust scuffs the hull; the ice comes aboard as deuterium.

missions.debrief: Primordial ice, older than the planets. Reyes is going to be insufferable for a week.

missions.title: Pods in the Dark
missions.briefing: Lifepods, calling at {pods}. Every one of them has a clock on its air. Get there and bring people in.

objectives.text: Pick up 3 lifepods before their air runs out
objectives.hint: PICK UP PODS: the tractor brings one in every few seconds, least air first. Survivors join the crew while it is short.

missions.debrief: Cold, scared and alive. Okafor's found them bunks; a couple are asking about work.

missions.title: Dead Stick
missions.briefing: {ship} has lost power and is calling for help. Get power back on and see her safely to where she's going. Moreau says watch yourself: not every call is honest.

objectives.hint: 60 s of Engineering work, or a hull patch kit at once. Her air stops running out once the power is back.
ESCORT (the card names her destination), then set course for that body: she follows, and flights are a little slower.

missions.debrief: Her master says to tell you that you didn't have to stop. We did, though.

missions.title: Into the Storm
missions.briefing: An ion storm at {storm}. Reyes wants readings from inside it. The closer we go the more we learn, and the more it costs the hull.

objectives.hint: RECORD at a ring: the outer ring is safe and slow, the inner ring fast but it wears the hull and can knock out sensors or engines.

missions.debrief: Reyes has the readings and the ship has a few new scorch marks. Fair trade, she says.
